title: AssessmentFramework
description: The external methodology used to conduct an assessment — its dimensions, criteria, indicators, scoring, maturity model and evidence requirements (CR-5 §5). External to the subject being assessed and versioned independently of OpenDEA Core (CR-5 §33).

id.description: Stable OpenDEA identifier (CR-3Q). Type prefix: dea:assessment_framework-

external_references.description: CR-3P: identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEA id (E004).

framework_version.description: Framework's own version, governed independently of the metamodel (A012).

authority.description: The body that owns and publishes the framework.

maturity_model_ref.description: Reference to the MaturityModel the framework defines, if any.

relationships.description: Derived convenience view (CR-1/CR-3): canonical relationship instances are authoritative.
